title: Elephant Random Walks on Coverings of Dipole Graphs
summary: In the present paper, we introduce and analyze elephant random walks (ERWs) on bipartite periodic lattices arising as coverings of dipole graphs. We focus on lattices whose admissible step directions in the two parts of the bipartition are negatives of each other and disjoint. On such graphs, we define an ERW in which each step is chosen by referring to the entire history of the walk. The ERW on the hexagonal lattice is a prototypical example of our model.
